walkthrough:
Calculate the central angle $\theta = \angle AOC$ from the arc length formula $s = r\theta$:
$$6 = 5\theta \implies \theta = \frac{6}{5} = 1.2 \text{ radians}$$

Find the length $AB$ and the area of the right-angled triangle $OAB$:
$$AB = 5\tan(1.2) \approx 5(2.5722) \approx 12.8608 \text{ cm}$$
$$\text{Area}(\triangle OAB) = \frac{1}{2} \times OA \times AB = \frac{1}{2}(5)(12.8608) \approx 32.152 \text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the sector area and subtract it from the triangle area (to 3 significant figures):
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } OAC) = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \theta = \frac{1}{2}(5^2)(1.2) = 15 \text{ cm}^2$$
$$\text{Shaded Area} = 32.152 - 15 = 17.152 \approx 17.2 \text{ cm}^2$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure: Finds angle $\theta = 1.2$ rad (M1). Finds triangle area $\approx 32.15\text{ cm}^2$ (DM2). Finds sector area $15\text{ cm}^2$ (DM1). Obtains shaded area $17.2\text{ cm}^2$ (A1).
